registry_scope: registry config is for the two GPT contributor assignments; Kimi and DeepSeek executed configurations are in additional_configurations.
selection_rule: Preserve published Dev20. GPT extra tasks retain earliest verified file captures from audited campaigns. Kimi and DeepSeek preserve their pre-continuation inventories and append the disjoint completed continuation tasks. Legacy capture and recovery provenance stays explicit; no score-based selection.
source_access: Redacted captures are under records/. Original byte captures and historical attempts remain in local source campaigns; provenance paths are not download links.
verification: Frozen campaign source/plan/prior evidence and attempt-file checks; current canonical task/rubric fingerprints. Native captures use native inspection or stage/checkpoint verification. Kimi acknowledged-write recovery was replayed byte-for-byte; DeepSeek legacy final-response captures retain their explicit prior adjudication and hashes. Runtime versions and capture modes remain distinct.
